entries.source: Urkundenbuch des Cistercienserstiftes B. Mariae V. zu Hohenfurt in Böhmen, Nr. LXXXV. , S. 99, LXXXV.
entries.german:
1341. 24. Juni. Hohenfurt. — Dominik von Passauergchlag gibt zu einem rechten Seelgeräthe der Samnung des Klosters zu Hohenfurt zwei Lehen in dem Dorf e Gollitsch.

Ich Domyn von Passawerslag vergich vnd tven chunt offenbar an disem prief allen den, di in sehent oder lesent oder hoerent lesen, daz ich mit wol verdachtem mvet vnd mit meiner pesten vrevnt rat durch meiner sei willen vnd aller meiner voruodern sei ze einem rechten selgeraet gib vnd geben han der gemain der samnung dez chlosters dacz dem Hohenfuert ze einer pesservng irer pfrvent zway leben, dacz Kalicz in dem dorf, daz mein vreis vnd mein rechts aygen ist gewesen, vnd daz niderhalb des weges zder tenken haut leit, da man von Passawerslag gen Chrumnaw reitt, da izunt aufge sessen sint Jacob vnd Haertel vnd Andre der richter, in allem dem recht vnd ichs in aygens recht mit allem nuez herpracht han, also gib ichs ledichleich der samnung dez vor geschriben chlosters ze Hohenfuert. Also beschaidenleich ob ich verschied an gerben, dez got nicht engeh, wem dann daz aygen augeviell, der schol der vor genanten samnung ze Hohenfuert geben dreizzichk schok grosser phenning Prager mvense, so wirt daz aygen von in ledig. Di weil man in dez vorgenanten gvet nicht geit, so schullen si is inne haben in allem dem recht, vnd si ander ir aygen gvet inne habent. Vnd dar vmb pitt ich meinen genaedigen herren hern Petern von Rosenberch, daz er diser sach vnd diser red rechter zevg vnd schermer mit seinem insigel an disem prief sey. Vnd ich Domyn von Passawerslag gib se disen prief ze einem rechten vrchvend vnd zv einer bestaetigvng, daz disev red gancz vnd vnzebrochen beleih ewichleich, wol ver- sigelt mit meinem insigel. Diser prief ist gegeben ze Hohenfurt in dem chloster, da von Christes gehurt ergangen warn drevczehen- hundert jar, dar nach in dem ain vnd viertzigisten jar an sand Jo hannes tag ze sunbenten. Zwei kleine, an Pergamentstreifen hängende Siegel in weissem Wachs. a) Siegel Peter's von Rosenberg wie in LXXXII. b) Ein Schild, worauf eine Mannesgestalt (ein Mönch?), die den Zeigefinger der Rechten erhoben und in der Linken eine Rolle oder einen Stock halt..— f S. Dominic, [i . De.] (?) Passawerslag.
entries.english:
1341, 24 June, Hohenfurt. — Dominik von Passauerslag gives the Hohenfurt monastery community two fiefs in the village of Gollitsch as a perpetual endowment for the salvation of souls.

I, Domyn von Passawerslag, confess and make publicly known by this charter to all who see it, read it, or hear it read, that, after due deliberation and on the advice of my best friends, for the sake of my soul and the souls of all my forebears, I give and have given as a rightful soul-endowment to the community of the monastery at Hohenfurt, to improve its provision, two fiefs at Kalicz in the village, which have been my free and rightful property and lie below the road on the left-hand side along the route from Passawerslag to Krumau, where Jacob, Haertel, and Andre the judge are now settled. I give them to the aforesaid community of the monastery at Hohenfurt freely, with all the rights and benefits by which I held them as free property. I stipulate that, if I should die without an heir, which may God forbid, whoever then inherits the property shall pay the aforesaid community at Hohenfurt thirty score Prague groschen; then the property will be released from them. Until that payment is made for the aforesaid property, they shall hold it with all the rights with which they hold their other property. In witness of this matter I ask my gracious lord, Peter von Rosenberg, to serve as a true witness and protector of this agreement with his seal on this charter. I, Domyn von Passawerslag, issue this charter as a rightful instrument and confirmation, so that this agreement may remain whole and unbroken forever, sealed with my seal. This charter was issued at the monastery of Hohenfurt in the year 1341 after the birth of Christ, on the feast of Saint John the Baptist.

Two small seals in white wax hang from parchment strips. (a) Peter von Rosenberg's seal, as in no. LXXXII. (b) A shield bearing a male figure (perhaps a monk), raising the index finger of his right hand and holding a scroll or staff in his left. — Seal of Dominic [de] Passawerslag.
